Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS). **A whole new look.**

### New

- **A new look for the lyrics.** They now start in the **Arc** layout: only the line being sung, on a gentle curve, in bold periwinkle letters with a solid 3D edge. Words come in as they are sung, in little groups that each lean and size a bit differently, and the next word waits faintly before it's sung. Each line appears where you're looking and stays there until the whole line drifts away. Pick the layout under **Lyrics → Layout**:
  - **Arc**: one line on a gentle curve.
  - **Lines**: the previous, current and next lines, straight and centred, like before.
  - **World**: each word or two pops up in the world as it's sung, in big bold capitals, scattered across the sky a little above where you're looking. The words drift slowly upwards, turn to face you as you walk around them, and grey out and fade away once the next words come.
- **Bold letters and Depth.** **Look → Font** now has four choices: Bold (the new default), Smooth, Handwritten and Minecraft. **Look → Depth** gives the letters a solid edge so they look raised. The glow now starts at zero; turn **Look → Glow** up if you liked it.
- **A new top bar.** A rounded bar that grows and shrinks with each line, with the cover, the words lighting up as they're sung and a highlight that glides along. The clock sits on its left and your frames per second and ping on its right; turn either off under **Display → Top bar** (**Clock** and **Stats**). It also moves below boss bars instead of covering them.
- **Themes.** **Look → Themes** sets the whole look in one click: Neon, Minimal, Karaoke, Retro, Dreamy or Rainbow. Change anything by hand and it shows Custom.
- **More top bar options.** Between lines (and before the first one) the bar shows the song's title and artist. Under **Display → Top bar** you can put it at the **Top** or the **Bottom** (just above the hotbar), change its **Size**, **Background** darkness and **Accent colour**, and turn the **Album picture** and the little **Equaliser** on or off. **Show bar** can be set to only appear while the lyrics in the world are out of view.
- **Choose where lyrics show.** **Display** can hide the lyrics in the Nether, the End, underwater, in caves (when there's no open sky above you) and in multiplayer.
- **Three new night skies**: **Synthwave**, a purple sky with a big striped retro sun low down; **Eclipse**, a black sun with a glowing ring and flare under a faint milky way; and **Moonlight**, a big full moon with a soft glow over slow clouds drifting round the horizon. Also new: **Aurora + nebula**, with northern lights over a soft coloured cloud. Pick them under **Look → Night sky**. **Constellations** joins some of the stars with thin lines.
- **More night sky options**: **Shooting stars** (more of them when the lyrics are busy), **Twinkling stars** around the lyrics, **Sky colours** (Classic, from the album, or the lyrics colour) and **Sky speed** (Slow, Normal or Fast).
- New soft colours to pick from: periwinkle, pink, lavender, sky blue and cream.
- Liked the old look? Set **Lyrics → Layout** to Lines, **Look → Font** to Smooth, turn **Depth** off, turn **Glow** up and set **Colour** to Album.

### Better

- Smoother frame rate with the glow turned on: each word's glow is drawn with far fewer copies, at the same brightness.
- The settings screen reads correctly in Hebrew, and its arrows point the right way.

Install: drop the jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API (see the [README](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics#install)).
